q: Which condition made the drop evaporate fastest?
How many times faster did the drop evaporate with the fan than in normal conditions?
Rank the single factors from most to least effective.
Fan (6 min), spread out (8 min), warm tile (9 min), compared with 20 min normally.
Use particles to explain why combining all three factors gave the fastest result.

Warmth gives particles more energy so more can escape; spreading out gives a larger surface so more particles are at the surface; the fan carries away escaped particles so they do not return. Together they all increase the rate.
